comment: She can teach HELL 101 and I would take the class. She is the GOAT and she never fail.

The GOAT. 
shes the best
What else can you ask for?
She is amazing-- she is what every professor should be: knowledgable, genuinely cares for her students, reasonable, accessible, and just a great person in general. Love Dr. Jones!!!!
Yaaaaaaas
Nicest teacher I have ever had, and her lectures are fun and easy to follow!

Dr. Jones my favorite UR prof so far. She is really kind, humorous, approachable and she cares to make her lecture slides well detailed. Lenient grader. She does reviews before tests. Hard to fail with her.

Dr. Jones is such a caring and genuine teacher. She is always cheerful and full of light when she teaches and when she interacts with students. Her lectures are easy to follow and understand, and the tests are fair.
Dr. Jones is an amazing professor who cares about her students! Very good at teaching and always willing to help with any questions. Easily one of my fave profs at UR! She is awesome.

Dr. Jones is the best professor anybody could ask for. She definitely deserves the 5.0 rating she has because she embodies all of the qualities of a perfect teacher. She makes sure to carefully explain all the material during class, which she is very passionate about, and she is always available outside of class to clarify anything on the homew

I absolutely love Dr. Jones. She truly cares so much about her student and ensures that they truly understand the topics. Her lectures are very interesting. You can clearly tell that she's passionate about what she's teaching. Benefit from office hours if you can, she's always welcoming.

Dr. Jones cares so much about her students. Her lectures are so interesting and she's really passionate about what she's teaching!! Def take a course with her if you can and know that she is super accessible out of class and so friendly.

She is the best professor I have ever had! She is caring and really pushes you to become the best student you can be. The course has hard material, but she makes it easy to learn! If you have any questions, she answers them clearly and does not stop explaining until you understand!

Dr. Jones always makes sure her students get the help needed to do well in her class while also making her students work for their success. She is very energetic and brings a positive light to class everyday. Not only is she there for her students in class, she is also a positive force for her students outside of the classroom as an overall gem.

Dr. Jones is one of the best professors I've had all year. She is the reason I am pushing myself to keep working on my future in the medical field. She is the sweetest, most welcoming professor ever and I am grateful she was my professor all year long. I met her the summer before my freshman year and it was an instant connection.

Dr. Jones cares a lot about her students. She is a fair grader and is very straightforward. Her tests are predictable, which is a good thing. She hosts study sessions and is usually available in her office for any help. You will love her and would want to major in biology after her course!

I had Dr. Jones for SMART, and she was the best. She was organized, informative, and clear about what she wanted. She's also super nice and approachable. I was sad that I couldn't take her again for Bio 200.
Love Dr. Jones; I would take her again in a heart beat.

Dr. Jones is an amazing professor and my favorite at UR. She cares about her students and is always there for extra help when needed. Her tests are challenging, but fair. I would definitely take Dr. Jones again in the future!
She wants all her students to do well. I'm so glad I took her.

I highly recommend Dr. Jones. She teaches the material very well and is very approachable and helpful. This was definitely on of my favorite classes. The classes are very interactive with polls and discussion. She gives fair feedback and grading.

Dr. Jones has only been at Richmond for one year, but she is one of the best professors in the bio department. For our final extra credit we made a model of intracellular communication with cookies and icing. She has already been promoted to the IQS program and has a  bright future ahead of her.
I LOVE DR. JONES! She is a great professor that really cares about her students. She is also nice and open to new ideas. She is really smart and hardworking! One of the best prof. at UR
Absolutely loved the class and professor; so helpful and interactive. Made me love biology.

One of the most amazing bio professors I have had. Her research is about teaching and how student learn, so she is always bringing new interactive learning methods to class such as hands on activities, taking anonymous polls, and discussing questions with a partner. She has clear expectations and loves helping her students understand the material.
